name: optcatalog_capture_hit_snapshot_and_invoke_damage_timer_callback
description: OptCatalog::CaptureHitSnapshotAndInvokeDamageTimerCallback optionally captures source and hit positions, then invokes the node damage timer callback and returns its float result.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent OptCatalog/zWeapon source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4b2880 validates the fastcall sourcePos/hitEvent ABI, damage amount as the stack float argument, damageHandler lookup through hitEvent->hitNode at node free-list offset 0xbc, optional global source/hit snapshot copy when g_OptCatalog_CaptureHitSnapshotEnabled equals 1, and indirect timer callback dispatch through handler offset 0x0c with handler context at offset 0x08.

The native smoke builds the node free-list damage-handler layout, verifies callback context and damage arguments plus the returned float, checks captured source and hit positions when enabled, and checks that disabled capture preserves the existing globals.
